page.overview:
Who is Aiden?

Aiden was a character in The Young Guardians.

Aiden was an infiltrator from House Harkonnen sent with a group to Cala City to pose as aspirants to the House Guard of House Atreides. During his time there, Aiden and his group antagonised Taron, Lyra and Eamon. They were assigned to the Peak of Valor challenge, a two-day endurance race to planet their flag at the summit of Mount Syubi. Aiden and his group reached the summit first and claimed victory by planting their flag.

Aiden entered the commandant's office that day before graduation and stole his code book, but was seen by Taron and Lyra. As he and his group rose to the stage at the graduation ceremony to receive top of class honors, the commandant had them arrested for espionage and treason. Aiden protested, claiming it to be a misunderstanding and demanding to be unhanded. The commandant pointed out that it was wartime and invoked kanly, killing Aiden and his group by slashing their throats.
